+ Tackle success 100%, up from your usual 67%. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 26 passes (up from your usual 20). You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu.

Rome wasn't built in a day; neither is a great player. - Coach Lasso
